name: Sam Thompson
education: B.S. in Computer Engineering, University of Texas at Austin
summary: Senior ML Platform Engineer with seven years of experience building self-serve Kubernetes platforms for ML. Operates MLflow for experiment tracking and model serving, hardens CI/CD for reproducible model releases, and manages infrastructure with Terraform.
strengths: Designs and operates Kubernetes-based ML platforms with MLflow at scale
Builds and hardens CI/CD pipelines for fast, auditable, reproducible model releases

gaps: Less hands-on data science work; focused on platform and infrastructure

resumeText: Sam Thompson is a Senior ML Platform Engineer at Harborview Analytics with seven years of experience, starting as a data engineer before moving into the ML platform space. He designs and operates Kubernetes-based platforms with MLflow for experiment tracking and model serving, hardens CI/CD so model releases are fast and reproducible, and manages infrastructure with Terraform. He mentors engineers across the platform team and sets technical direction for self-serve ML infrastructure.
